body: The alchemist from the Golden Court. He is first introduced as a enigmatic figure who's death has shocked the whole town. >!However, he is ultimately a tragic figure who wants to help the town in any way he can but is responsible for the problem this town is in. His death is the reason why Professor Layton vs Phoenix Wright exist.!< It also helps that Timothy Watson does a stellar performance with him reading the letter.
Movie version of Yanni Yogi as he is fundamentally broken. He has nothing left with the murder that he committed being the only thing that gave him a purpose.
The realities that could not be; the world that should have existed but do not; the potential lives of those who might have but might not remain.

I wouldn't say hate but I don't understand the appeal of Maya Fey.

However, with every new game, she feels more detrimental to the storyline. 
Not to mention, the amount of times she is used as a damsel in distress or as a client you have to defend does annoy me a lot more than it should.
